name: The Fiery Scion
source:
You play as a young mage just getting out after over a decade of confinement. Powerful, but raw, he needs to learn to tame his Flame, a powerful elemental magic that he inherited from his absentee father.

You will follow him as he recruits his party, goes on adventures, make friends and lovers, and populates his harem. And, more importantly, gets all his women pregnant!

But danger loom over the world...demons from another plane try to invade, again and again. Last time, they were repelled by a group of Heroes, led by the main character teacher, at a great price. Now, decades later, they threaten the world again.

[From [url=https://vanderer.itch.io/the-fiery-scion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一位年轻法师，刚刚结束长达十余年的禁闭。他拥有强大却未经磨炼的力量，需要学会驾驭自己的“烈焰”，那是从缺席人生的父亲那里继承的强大元素魔法。

你将跟随他招募队员、踏上冒险、结交朋友与恋人，并扩充自己的后宫。更重要的是，让所有伴侣都怀上孩子！

然而，危险正笼罩世界…来自另一个位面的恶魔，一次又一次试图入侵。上一次，主人公的老师率领一群英雄，以惨重的代价击退了它们。如今，数十年过去，恶魔再次威胁着这个世界。

[摘自[url=https://vanderer.itch.io/the-fiery-scion]itch.io[/url]]
